license.name: Commercial Installations Inc
license.registry: North Carolina Licensing Board for General Contractors: public license search (portal.nclbgc.org/Public/Search)
license.note: Checked 2026-11-19. The company-name searches 'Commercial Installations' (exact and soundex) returned no results. A search on the company phone, 919-365-5666, also returned nothing. The broader search 'Commercial Installation' matched only L.70351, Commercial Installation & Construction Company of Saint Louis MO, which is archived and expired 12/31/2021. That is a different business, not this Raleigh company. The company site (https://www.commercialinstallations.com/) gives the base city as Raleigh NC and the phone as (919) 365-5666. It lists toilet partitions among its Division 10 installation scopes and says it works mainly for general contractors. The site names no license number. NC requires a licensed general contractor only for projects of $40,000 or more, so no state license is needed on smaller jobs or where the company works under a licensed GC. Ask the company for any license held under another legal name.
